caption: The drawing depicts a multi-tool utensil consisting of a knife, a two-pronged fork, and a spoon, all attached to a single handle. The handle appears to be wooden and has a brown color, detailed with small brass-colored rivets. The knife and fork are metallic with a grayish-silver sheen, shown folded out from one end of the handle, while the spoon, also metallic and gray, extends from the opposite end. The multi-tool is drawn on a plain, undecorated light beige background. In the lower right corner, there is a small, rectangular line drawing that outlines the utensils in both the folded and unfolded arrangements. Near the lower left corner, the name "Vincent P. Rossi" and the numbers "2341" appear handwritten in red ink.
title: Officer's Mess Knife
